answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can rest on bonded identity: every agent locks scarce value before it may transact. On the open tundra of registration, spawning a thousand clones is free, but each bond drains the attacker's capital, while an honest agent treats its single bond like an oasis it cannot abandon. Attestations then act as a slow signal earned only after real, graded work, so cheap clones cannot fast-track credibility. Misbehavior triggers slashing, and because clusters share funding, one fraud collapses the whole syb net at once.
